versions.changelog:
Initial release: Comprehensive histology & embryology skill pack based on the PMPH 10th Edition textbook.

- Includes 124 core skills covering histology, embryology, congenital malformations, and clinical-pathological correlation.
- Supports multiple languages: Chinese (zh-CN), English, Japanese, French, Russian.
- Organized skill registry for efficient navigation by topic (e.g., tissue types, clinical relevance).
- Tags and categories to facilitate use in medical education and clinical skill development.
